svg.title: Actual observed acoustic dispatch and PCM clipping
svg.desc: Upper: three formant parameter frequencies and pitch from periodic wavegen dispatches, indexed by dispatch not utterance time. Lower: first 60ms of generated explicit-probe waveform and gain-four saturated transformation. Trace only periodic branch, unvoiced sampled sounds are not these rows.
svg.text: A. Actual periodic-branch parameters (dispatch index, not milliseconds)
B. Post-decoder intervention: same PCM, gain 4 then saturation
Blue: original; red: transformed. Distortion measured digitally; human impact not tested.
